answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. The ferrous holds work receipts rather than names, so the canyon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
